national_news.title: Home Minister Sets One-Year Target for 100% Implementation of New Criminal Laws
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the National Security Strategies Conference (NSSC) in New Delhi, setting a 100% implementation deadline for the three new criminal justice laws within one year.
The goal is to ensure case resolution up to the Supreme Court level within three years and increase the overall conviction rate by 25%.

Key initiatives outlined include the 'Narcotics Control Vision Document 2026-2029' based on the 'Detect, Disrupt, Destroy' strategy, a quadrilateral border security approach, and integrating platforms like CCTNS, ICJS, NatGrid, and NAFIS.

national_news.title: Regional Rural Banks Register Highest-Ever Net Profit of Rs 10,176 Crore in FY26
bullets: India's 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) achieved a record consolidated net profit of Rs 10,176 crore in FY26, representing a 49% jump from Rs 6,820 crore in the previous fiscal year.
Asset quality reached historic lows with Gross NPAs dropping to 5.3% and Net NPAs to 2.1%, while total business crossed Rs 13.5 lakh crore and the Credit-Deposit ratio hit an all-time high of 75.2%.
Operating across 22,273 branches in 26 states and 3 UTs, RRBs met all Priority Sector Lending targets and opened over 54.98 lakh new Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) accounts.

national_news.title: PM Marks 10 Years of Unified Payments Interface as Key Digital Infrastructure Pillar
bullets: Unified Payments Interface (UPI), launched in 2016, completed 10 years as a core pillar of India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) and is now operational across 11 countries.
According to the Finance Ministry, annual UPI transaction volume increased from 1.78 crore in FY 2016-17 to over 24,162 crore in FY 2025-26, marking an almost 13,000-fold growth.
Total transaction value grew sharply from 7,000 crore rupees to nearly 314 lakh crore rupees during the same period, significantly boosting financial inclusion across the nation.

national_news.title: Supreme Court to Consider Special Bench on OBC Creamy-Layer Criteria
bullets: The Supreme Court agreed to consider forming a special bench to hear the Centre's plea on the applicability of OBC creamy-layer criteria for Civil Services Examination 2025 candidate allocations.

The Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) sought permission to proceed with service allocations for 958 UPSC-recommended candidates using criteria applied prior to the apex court's March 11 verdict.

The March 11 judgment in Union of India vs Rohith Nathan ruled that the October 14, 2004 clarifying letter cannot override the September 8, 1993 office memorandum, and parent salary alone cannot be the sole criterion for creamy-layer exclusion.

national_news.title: India Pitches Data Centre Hub and High-Tech Manufacturing Partnerships with Japan
bullets: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal met Japanese Economy Minister Akazawa Ryosei in Tokyo, pitching India as a data centre hub backed by $200 billion investment commitments from global hyperscalers.

The Indian government is developing a framework to exempt high-tech sector companies, including those from Japan, from mandatory Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for manufacturing equipment.
The initiative supports the Make in India program to meet India's projected semiconductor demand of $150 billion by 2032 and advance the vision of becoming a $30 trillion economy by 2047.

national_news.title: National Traders' Welfare Board Conducts 100th Virtual Interaction Meeting
bullets: The National Traders' Welfare Board (NTWB), under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, held its 100th Virtual Conference Interaction Meeting chaired by NTWB Chairman Sunil J. Singhi.
The virtual engagement platform was approved during the Board's second meeting in February 2024 and formally launched in July 2024 to facilitate continuous government-trader dialogue.
The structured weekly platform conducts interactions every Monday to address retail traders' grievances, spread awareness about central schemes, and submit recommendations to concerned ministries.

national_news.title: MoHFW and ICMR Monitor Seasonal Influenza Trends via Pan-India VRDL Network
bullets: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), along with DHR, ICMR, and NCDC, is monitoring national respiratory illness trends through 73 Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratories (VRDLs).
ICMR Director General Dr. Rajiv Bahl confirmed that circulating Influenza A (H1N1) matches the A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1) pdm09-like virus, classified under clade 6B.1A.5a2a and subclade D.3.1.1.
Genomic surveillance indicates routine antigenic drift consistent with standard seasonal behavior, with no evidence of a new or high-risk influenza strain.

national_news.title: Bihar Participates in National Conference of I&PR Secretaries in New Delhi
bullets: Bihar Information and Public Relations Department Secretary Naveen Kumar represented the state at the National Conference of Information and Public Relations Secretaries held at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
Key topics discussed included the framework for WAVES 2027, 'WAVES Bazaar', capacity building via the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), and the 'India Cine Hub' single-window portal.
Deliberations covered the digital transition of media registration through the Press Sewa Portal under the Press and Registration of Periodicals (PRP) Act, 2023.
national_news.exam_tag: BPSC / Bihar State Governance & Central Initiatives

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Reassures Public on Seasonal H1N1 Antigenic Drift
bullets: Pan-India surveillance led by MoHFW, ICMR, DHR, and NCDC across 73 VRDL facilities confirmed circulating H1N1 viruses belong to clade 6B.1A.5a2a (subclade D.3.1.1).
ICMR DG Dr. Rajiv Bahl clarified that observed minor genetic changes represent standard seasonal antigenic drift rather than a novel public health threat.
Advisories highlight routine hygiene measures and targeted medical care for vulnerable demographics including the elderly, young children, and immunocompromised individuals.

national_news.title: AIIA Launches 'Garbhini Mitra' Skill-Development Course for Maternal Care
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi, launched 'Garbhini Mitra', a six-month offline healthcare skill-development training course for the 2026–2027 session.
The course integrates traditional Ayurvedic maternal care (Garbhadhana, Garbhini, and Sutika Paricharya) with modern non-clinical safety practices like Basic Life Support (BLS) and infection control.
Open to candidates aged 18 and above with 10+2 education, the program caps intake at 20 students per batch to train non-clinical support personnel for maternal and newborn wellness.

national_news.title: India Post Launches Upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa Mobile Applications
bullets: Union Minister of Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia launched the upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa applications and inaugurated 14 renovated Post Office buildings.
Developed indigenously by the Centre for Excellence in Postal Technology (CEPT) under the DoP IT 2.0 Modernization, the Dak Sewa app integrates postal services across 23 Indian languages.
Dak MITRA aims to empower postal workers with digital tools to streamline doorstep delivery and improve last-mile infrastructure.

national_news.title: RBI's USD-INR Swap Facility Mobilizes Record USD 73 Billion Forex Inflows
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) special USD-INR forex swap facility, launched on June 8, 2026, mobilized a record USD 73 billion in foreign exchange inflows within eleven weeks.
Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR(B)] deposits constituted USD 65.40 billion of the total inflows, making it India's largest and fastest foreign-currency mobilization exercise.

The mobilization comfortably surpassed the RBI's 2013 FCNR(B) swap scheme (which raised about USD 26 billion), prompting the RBI to advance the window's closing date from September 30 to August 31, 2026.

national_news.title: PM Modi Urges IFS Trainees to Expand Grassroots and Digital Diplomacy Globally
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed 50 Officer Trainees of the 2025 batch of the Indian Foreign Service (IFS) at Seva Teerth.
Urged young diplomats to act as catalytic agents for India's economic engagement, strengthen the digital presence of Indian Missions, and showcase India's civilisational strengths.
Suggested leveraging the 'Bharat ko Janiye' (Know India) Quiz alongside AI and gaming technologies to engage global youth and boost tourism.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Inaugurates 9th National Security Strategies Conference
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 9th National Security Strategies Conference in New Delhi, featuring over 850 hybrid participants across police and security establishments.
Directed the integration of AI-based analysis on the Multi-Agency Centre (MAC) platform and mandated training under the Home Ministry's PRAHAAR scheme.
Focused on counter-terrorism through UAPA investigations, trial in absentia for fugitives, narcotics control policy, proxy warfare, sub-aerial threats, and a national biosecurity framework.

national_news.title: India and China Hold 25th Round of Special Representatives' Boundary Talks
bullets: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held the 25th round of Special Representatives' Talks on the India-China Boundary issue in Beijing.
The Special Representatives mechanism, established in 2003, serves as the primary negotiation channel for resolving the bilateral border dispute.
The talks focused on maintaining peace and tranquillity along border areas as a prerequisite for bilateral ties, following the 24th round held in August 2024.

national_news.title: Puducherry Government Introduces Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026
bullets: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026 to shift business regulation from permission-based control to a rule-based governance model.
The Bill extends approval exemptions for MSMEs to five years, with a provision for a one-year extension, and introduces auto-generation of Acknowledgement Certificates if not issued on time.
It strengthens 'Invest Puducherry' as a single point of contact for investors and establishes an auto-appeal mechanism for applicants against rejected proposals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Launches 'Police Didi' Scheme and Student Support Portal
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary launched the 'Police Didi' initiative to deploy female police personnel in educational institutions, providing them with 2,700 scooties and over 2,000 motorcycles.
The state government reported that the emergency response time for the 'Dial 112' helpline has fallen below 10 minutes, with a target to bring it down to 5-7 minutes.
Under the JEEViKA initiative, 1.81 crore women are enrolled, including 43 lakh 'Lakhpati Didis', with a target to elevate 1 lakh more women into this category over the next two years.

bihar_news.title: NITI Aayog Releases 'Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat' Report
bullets: NITI Aayog released a report titled 'Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat', highlighting a severe structural imbalance between traditional higher education degrees and market employment needs.

Citing the Economic Survey 2024–25, the report noted that only 8.25% of graduates are employed in roles aligned to their qualifications, while graduate unemployment stands at 13% overall and 20.4% among graduate women.

The report highlighted that over 2 crore out of 3.4 crore undergraduate students are enrolled in generic BA, BSc, and BCom courses, advocating for Public-Private Partnership (PPP) models to modernize curricula.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Outlines Key Provisions of Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025
bullets: Bihar Industries Minister Shreyasi Singh highlighted key provisions of the Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025 aimed at accelerating industrialization in the state.
The policy offers 10 acres of land virtually free for enterprises generating employment for 1,000 people, interest subvention of up to Rs 40 crore, and State GST reimbursement.
The state administration demonstrated expedited land allocation within 24 hours and facilitated industrial production setup within a record 55 days.

bihar_news.title: Congress Demands Adoption of Bihar and Telangana Models for Nationwide Caste Census
bullets: The Indian National Congress has urged the Registrar General of India and the Ministry of Home Affairs to adopt the Bihar and Telangana state models for the upcoming nationwide caste census.
The party advocated replacing open-ended queries with a standardized drop-down menu format based on existing state and central caste lists to prevent data duplication.
Criticism was directed at the Union Home Ministry's 40-question census format notification, which places caste as a single open-ended query at question number 10.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Participates in National Conference of Information and Public Relations Secretaries
bullets: Bihar Information and Public Relations Department (IPRD) Secretary Naveen Kumar represented the state at the National Conference of State Information Secretaries in New Delhi.
Key agenda items included strengthening PIB-State IPRD coordination, utilizing IIMC for officer training, and digital transition via the Press Sewa Portal under the PRP Act, 2023.
Delegates deliberated on the 'WAVES 2027' framework, 'WAVES Bazaar', and the adoption of the 'India Cine Hub' single-window portal for film shooting permissions.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Proposes ₹70,000-Crore Extension for Ganga Marine Drive
bullets: Bihar announced a proposal to construct a 126-kilometre Marine Drive corridor along the Ganga River at an estimated cost of ₹70,000 crore.
The proposed funding structure comprises ₹20,000 crore from the Bihar state government and ₹50,000 crore expected from private sector investment.
The planned project will extend the existing 21-km J.P. Ganga Path in Patna towards Koilwar on the Son River to improve riverfront infrastructure and connectivity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Raises Concerns Over Renewal of 1996 Farakka Ganga Water Treaty
bullets: Bihar has raised concerns over flooding, siltation, and dry-season water availability ahead of the expiration of the 1996 India-Bangladesh Ganga Water Sharing Treaty in December 2026.
The 1996 Farakka Treaty establishes a 30-year formula-based framework for water sharing at Farakka Barrage (West Bengal) during the lean period (January 1 to May 31).
Bihar has requested scientific silt management, higher state representation in discussions, and accounting for its projected water requirements up to 2050.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Electoral Roll Exclusion Does Not Divest Welfare or Citizenship Rights
bullets: The Supreme Court observed that deletion from the electoral roll per se does not result in the denial of social security benefits, PDS ration, or citizenship claims.
Reaffirming its Bihar SIR judgment, the Court held that the Election Commission's inquiry is strictly limited to determining eligibility for electoral inclusion.
The ECI decision affects only voting rights and does not preclude determinations made by competent authorities under the Citizenship Act.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Leads National Mushroom Production Surge, Accounts for 12.02% Share
bullets: India's mushroom production surged from 51,000 tonnes in 2015 to 347,750 tonnes in 2024, registering a CAGR of 23.76%, according to FAO and ICAR data.
Bihar has emerged as the top producer in India, contributing 12.02% of total national output in 2023-24, followed by Odisha (9.86%) and Maharashtra (9.49%).
Growth was driven by initiatives under the Bihar Agriculture Roadmap, Mushroom Kit Vitaran Scheme, and training support from Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University (RPCAU).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Partners with ConveGenius.AI for State AI Stack
bullets: The Department of Information Technology, Bihar, signed an MoU with ConveGenius.AI to build the state's sovereign AI stack and infrastructure.
The project involves creating 'B-ONT', an ontological mind map acting as a unified knowledge graph for all state schemes and cross-departmental citizen services.
Under the agreement, the Government of Bihar retains full control over its data, AI governance, and policy controls while enhancing youth upskilling in AI capabilities.

bihar_news.title: IndiGo Launches Direct Gaya-Bangkok Flights to Boost Buddhist Tourism
bullets: IndiGo announced twice-weekly direct international flights connecting Gaya in Bihar with Bangkok, Thailand, commencing October 26, 2026.
The route significantly enhances air connectivity for Bodh Gaya, home to the UNESCO World Heritage Site Mahabodhi Temple, catering to international Buddhist pilgrims.
The new connectivity aims to strengthen Bihar's tourism ecosystem, cultural exchange, hospitality, and local transport infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Approves 336-km Six-Lane Greenfield Corridor from Buxar to Bhagalpur
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved a 336-km six-lane greenfield expressway corridor connecting Buxar to Bhagalpur, spanning across 12 districts including Bhojpur, Arwal, Jehanabad, Nalanda, Gaya, and Munger.
The infrastructure project will be executed through the Bihar State Road Development Corporation Limited (BSRDCL), with consultants appointed for preparing the Detailed Project Report (DPR).
In a related decision, Bihar's IT Department signed an MoU with Japanese company Tayo to develop an AI-based infrastructure platform for monitoring project execution.
